title_authors: Solubility of Hydrogen in Water, Seawater, and NaCl Solutions; Thomas E. Crozier and Sachio Yamamoto
experimental_method: Scholander microgasometric technique as modified by Douglas: about 6 ml degassed water equilibrated with H2 in a shaken vessel in a bath thermoregulated to 0.01 C; gas volume absorbed and water volume measured, Bunsen coefficient corrected 0.12% for partial molal volume (26 cm3/mol).
uncertainties_stated: estimated accuracy 0.5% (abstract); average deviation of data from fit 1.8e-5 beta; salinity accuracy 0.003 permil; bath +-0.01 C
quality_remarks: Salinities of the seawater series are 27.665, 33.680, 39.927 permil (diluted or evaporated); seawater not NaCl. Table I replicate temperatures are slightly scattered around nominal set points. Salinity units printed as permil/parts per thousand. No pressure other than the definition (760 mm partial pressure) is given. Table I/IV unit header text-layer showed '%' for Table IV; image shows permil.
not_extracted_tables: Table III: Bunsen coefficients calculated from the fitted equation (derived, smoothed)
